Agent: Hello, may I speak with Jane Smith?
Patient: Yes, this is Jane.
Agent: Hi Jane, I'm calling from City Clinic about your appointment on Monday 17 Aug at 10:00 AM. Are you still planning to attend?
Patient: Yes, I'll be there.
Agent: Wonderful. Has anything changed since you booked?
Patient: No, everything's fine.
Agent: Great, we'll see you then. Have a good day!
Patient: Thank you, bye.

evidence: Patient confirmed attendance at Monday 17 Aug 10:00 AM appointment
